description: Make an individual sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit). Needs an SFXMint API key on an account with credits: each take costs 2 credits per started 5 seconds (one credit is one library download), charged when it starts, and failed takes are given back. Without a key or credits it answers with buy_url; the user decides whether to buy, an agent never pays. Returns WAV files (signed links valid 15 minutes) with SHA-256 and ogg_url; if they are not ready within about 25 seconds, it returns the order id for get_generation. Not CC0: the user may use them in their own projects, commercially, but not redistribute them as standalone sound files or in a sound collection. AI-generated: the user should listen before use.

duration_s.description: Length of each take in seconds; leave it out and SFXMint chooses from the description. Each started 5 seconds costs 2 credits a take.

follow.description: How closely the takes follow the words: variety (default, for a short description), balanced, or close (for a detailed one); same price

prompt.description: What should be heard, in plain English (other languages are translated), at most 400 characters: the source, the action, the material, how it starts and ends. Mention only sounds to be heard.

variations.description: How many takes (default 2); each is charged

name: generate_sound
